title: When muted notifications are unmuted after a set time the notification sound stays muted if the unmuting happens at login
line: Notification sounds are unmuted again after logging in when Do Not Disturb ended while you were logged out.
explanation: While Do Not Disturb is on, the notifications applet mutes the 'Notification Sounds' stream and remembers that in plasmanotifyrc (NotificationSoundsMuted). It only unmuted the stream when 'inhibited' changed to false, but if the end time passes while logged out, inhibited starts false at login and never changes, so the stream stayed muted forever. The applet now also unmutes the stream (and clears the flag) whenever it shows up muted, or becomes muted, while Do Not Disturb is not active and the applet had muted it itself.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Unmute sounds if Do Not Disturb ended while logged out

Sounds were only unmuted when Do Not Disturb turned off, which never
happens at login once its end time has passed. Also unmute the stream
when it shows up muted by us while Do Not Disturb is no longer active.

BUG: 453281

media.caption: Master: after logging in past the Do Not Disturb end time, DND is off but Notification Sounds is still muted
Fixed: same steps, Notification Sounds is unmuted at login

reviews.text: The root cause and layer in Globals.qml are right, and the basic login-after-DND-expired case works. However, restoreNotificationSounds() has three real edge-case bugs: it does not check NotificationManager.Server.valid (so if PipeWire reports muted before the server is valid while DND is still active, it sends an async unmute() and clears the flag, which can race with onInhibitedChanged and leave DND unmuted), it is never called at startup or when Server.valid changes (so it misses streams already populated by the Volume applet's shared PulseAudio context), and keeping it hooked to onMutedChanged permanently without clearing a stale flag when the stream is already unmuted will immediately undo a user's later manual mute.
changes: Check NotificationManager.Server.valid inside restoreNotificationSounds() before unmuting so an active DND session is never prematurely unmuted before the notification server becomes valid, and also invoke restoreNotificationSounds() when NotificationManager.Server.valid becomes true.

Invoke restoreNotificationSounds() during initialization (e.g. in Component.onCompleted / pulseAudio.onLoaded) in addition to signal handlers, so already-populated notificationStream state (such as when the Volume applet initialized the shared PulseAudio context first) is handled.

Avoid fighting future manual mutes when notificationSoundsInhibited is stale: once Server.valid is true, !inhibited, and the stream's real initial muted state is known, ensure the one-time startup restoration either unmutes or clears the stale flag instead of permanently unmuting on every future onMutedChanged event.

reviews.text: The diagnosis is right: Globals.qml only unmuted the stream in onInhibitedChanged, which never fires when Do Not Disturb's end time passed while logged out, so NotificationSoundsMuted=true and the muted stream stayed forever. Reacting to both notificationStreamChanged and the stream's own mutedChanged, gated on !inhibited and the 'we muted it' flag, handles the delegate first showing up with muted=false, leaves user-muted streams alone, and is a no-op during the normal live DND on/off path (the handlers see consistent state). The brief unmute when the notification server isn't valid yet at login heals itself through onInhibitedChanged re-muting, and the Sound KCM before/after screenshots show the fix. Nit: restoreNotificationSounds duplicates the unmute branch of onInhibitedChanged and could share it, but that's not blocking.
